name: Deploy verification - portfolio.sync.completed by trigger and user
purpose: Confirm a sync-logic change immediately after deploy: duration, positions changed and provider-call outcomes for a manual sync, scoped to the operator's own user_id and the deploy_id that carried the change.

hyperdx.select: timestamp, deploy_id, trigger, user_id, broker, account_id, duration_ms, positions_seen, positions_changed, provider_calls, outcome

operator_notes: Scope the search to your own sync: add AND user_id:usr_123 (your id) to the WHERE box; compare releases by adding AND deploy_id:1a2b3c4.
Manual syncs carry trigger:manual, scheduled runs trigger:scheduled - the second is the regression baseline.
provider_calls is JSON-serialized (positions_fetch, positions_persist, accounts_reconcile, securities_resolved); open a row to inspect it instead of adding it to the column list.
clickhouse_sql:
SELECT
    SpanAttributes['trigger'] AS trigger,
    SpanAttributes['user_id'] AS user_id,
    SpanAttributes['deploy_id'] AS deploy_id,
    count() AS sampled_syncs,
    quantile(0.5)(toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['duration_ms'])) AS p50_duration_ms,
    quantile(0.95)(toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['duration_ms'])) AS p95_duration_ms,
    sum(toInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['positions_changed'])) AS positions_changed
FROM default.otel_traces
WHERE SpanAttributes['event.name'] = 'portfolio.sync.completed'
  AND SpanAttributes['trigger'] = 'manual'
  AND SpanAttributes['user_id'] = 'usr_123' -- replace with your own user id
  AND Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY
GROUP BY trigger, user_id, deploy_id
ORDER BY sampled_syncs DESC
expected_result: One row per (trigger, user_id, deploy_id) in the window; a fresh manual sync shows up within seconds of the gateway decision window (README section 6). p95_duration_ms and positions_changed are the fields to eyeball against the pre-deploy baseline.
sampling_and_retention: portfolio.sync.completed is part of the successful bulk: only about OTEL_SAMPLER_SUCCESS_PERCENT percent (default 7) of those traces are stored, so counts are a sample - compare rates, not absolute counts, and divide by event.sample_rate for an estimate. Failures in the same window are complete: portfolio.sync.failed is retained at 100 percent. Retention tier: 30 days (README section 5).
